invariants: Operations accepts rather than rewrites the frozen scientific design
RACI records responsibility but does not create authority
Every work package has inspectable acceptance evidence
Critical path forecasts preserve uncertainty and external lead times
Participant exam series lesion mask specimen and run units remain distinct
Readiness is domain specific and evidence backed
No universal accrual or traffic-light threshold is invented
Risk issue decision change deviation and incident remain separate
Critical-to-quality factors have prevention detection and escalation
Scanner protocol reconstruction and software changes trigger impact review
A freeze identifies scope version criteria authorization and exceptions
Post-freeze changes create new versions and downstream staleness
Protected-test access breaches cannot be hidden as operations
Recovery cannot cure invalid unauthorized or unsafe science
Pause and termination preserve safety access and record obligations
Closeout reconciles people cases images specimens data resources and records
The skill does not activate sites approve spending sign contracts or manage staff
Clinical-trial sources apply only after project applicability is verified
Post-award reporting binds one exact award reporting period and authoritative term versions
Proposed amendments authorized amendments and actual deviations remain separate
Scientific methods results and claims remain with their original scientific owners
The maximum machine reporting state is HUMAN_INSTITUTIONAL_FUNDER_ACTION_REQUIRED
